verdict.rationale: Banking is well covered. Zoho Books documents connecting bank and credit card accounts with transactions "flowing into Zoho Books automatically," plus auto-categorization and reconciliation, and the banking API exposes categorization, reconciliation and bank-rules endpoints. Payments get only a bare "Online Payments" feature heading. Payroll does not appear anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: any evidence of payroll integration feeding the ledger, documentation of payment-processor/gateway connections that auto-post to the ledger, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bank feed reliability.
